summaryZh: 荷兰农业机器人公司AIGRO于2026年10月19日被法院宣告破产，此前其暂停付款程序已终止。该公司成立于2019年，主打产品AIGRO UP是一款轻量化自主工具载体，可执行除草、割草等任务，单次充电可工作长达10小时。CEO确认破产但拒绝透露原因，表示管理层正努力寻求重启，但能否成功尚不确定。该事件反映了农业机器人领域初创企业面临的商业化挑战。

contentFull:
Dutch robot builder AIGRO declared bankrupt

 22-10 | Field robots | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Photo: AIGRO

Dutch robot maker AIGRO from Best has been declared bankrupt. The court pronounced the bankruptcy on 19 October 2026, after the suspension of payments had been terminated.

AIGRO develops robots for sustainable agriculture. Its best-known product is the AIGRO UP, an autonomous tool carrier that can perform tasks such as weeding and mowing. The machine is lightweight and can work for up to ten hours between charge cycles. The company was founded in 2019.

Little to say publicly

CEO Wim Reijersen van Buuren confirms that the bankruptcy has been pronounced, but declines to comment on the cause. He says there is currently little to say publicly. On a possible sale of the robots or a restart, he says this is in the hands of the trustee. According to him, owners and users of AIGRO robots have already been informed.

Reijersen van Buuren says the management is trying to achieve a restart as soon as possible. He sincerely hopes to find a party to make that possible, but cannot yet say whether this will succeed.

translationZh:
荷兰贝斯特市的机器人制造商AIGRO已被宣告破产。法院于2026年10月19日宣布破产，此前暂停付款程序已终止。

AIGRO致力于开发可持续农业机器人。其最知名的产品是AIGRO UP，一款自主工具载体，可执行除草和割草等任务。该机器重量轻，单次充电可工作长达十小时。公司成立于2019年。

**公开信息有限**

CEO维姆·赖耶尔森·范布伦确认破产已宣判，但拒绝就原因发表评论。他表示目前公开信息有限。关于机器人可能出售或重启事宜，他表示这由受托人负责。据他称，AIGRO机器人的所有者与用户已被告知相关情况。

赖耶尔森·范布伦表示，管理层正努力尽快实现重启。他真诚希望找到能够促成此事的合作方，但尚无法确定能否成功。
author: René Groeneveld
